description:
the clock is when we leave the hotel. add a 24h clock dial right of the map: drag the hand to set the leave time (label hh:mm), under it one compact row of seven small day buttons Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su that fits the column, left/right arrow keys nudge 15 min while the dial has focus. start Tue 06:30.
    draw input `isochrones` (geojson: 30, 20, 10 minute bike reach from the hotel) as three translucent blue bands under the shops, darker the closer; the km circle stays on top.
    every shop inside the circle gets a small label 'hh:mm' = leave time + its bike_min (minutes by bike from the hotel). parse the osm `hours` text ('Mo-Sa 04:00-14:00; Su 05:00-14:00', '24/7', '05:00-20:00', 'Mo-Fr 05:00-21:00; Sa-Su 06:00-21:00', blank = unknown).
    open at that arrival time and day → solid dot and green label; closed at arrival → hollow ring and red label; unknown hours → dashed ring and grey label.
    badge: '<n> inside · <k> independent · <j> open on arrival'. turning the hand or changing the day restyles every dot and label live.
